༄༅/ /gnyis pa sgra rgyan gyi rnam gzhag

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gnyis pa sgra rgyan gyi rnam gzhag

na mo swa ra swa st+yai/ gnyis pa sgra rgyan gyi rnam gzhag la gsum/ zung ldan gyi rnam gzhagabya dka' ba'i khyad par gzhan/ dbyangs gsal nges pa'i bya dka' bshad pa'o/ /dang po la drugabya sla ba rkang pa'i dang po na yod pa'i zung ldan/ bya dka' ba gnas gzhan na yod pa'i zung ldan/ mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan/ kun du zung ldan/ bsres pa'i zung ldan/ bzlog pa'i zung ldan no/ /dang po la gsum/ bar du ma chod pa/ bar du chod pa/ chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan no/ /dang po la bco lnga ste/ rkang dang po'i thog ma na yod pa/ gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa dang*/ bzhi ba'i thog ma na yod pa dang*/ dang po gnyis kyi thog ma na yod pa/ dang po dang gsum pa'i thog ma na yod pa/ dang po dang bzhi pa'i thog ma na yod pa/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i thog ma na yod pa/ gnyis pa dang bzhi pa'i thog ma na yod pa/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa'i thog ma na yod pa/ dang po gsum gyi thog ma na yod pa/ snga ma gnyis dang bzhi pa'i thog ma ma yod pa/ phyi ma gnyis dang dang po'i thog ma na yod pa/ phyi ma gsum gyi thog ma na yod pa/ bzhi ka'i thog ma na yod pa'i zung ldan no/ /'di dag thams cad bkod na mang du dogs pas mtshon tsam la dang po'i thog ma na yod pa ni/ 'dzum 'dzum zhal gyi sgo khyim las/ /bgrang yas spros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /nyi 'od zil mnan 'dod gzugs lha'i/ /mngon rlom 'joms mdzad shākya'i rgyal/ /zhes dang*/ dang po dang gnyis pa'i thog ma na yod pa ni/ /gsal gsal zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ /snyan snyan rgyud mangs sbreng mdzad cing*/ /'jo sgeg nyams kyis rol pa can/ /tshangs sras lha mo rgyal ba'i yum/ /zhes dang*/ dang po gsum gyi thog ma na yod pa ni/ bzang bzang rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /yang yang mgrin gcig rab bsngags pa/ /mang mang rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i gter/ /rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lor 'dud/ /ces dang*/ bzhi ka'i thog mar yod pa ni/ zab zab lung rigs brgya phrag gis/

/blun blun gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /nges nges tshar gcod chos kyi rje/ /mkhas mkhas rgyal ba gnyis par grags/ /zhes dang*/ thog mtha' gnyis na yod pa ni/ bzang bzang thub pa'i mdo sngags bstan/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin du/ /sa gsum 'gro na nyi ma ltar/ /lhang lhang gsal mdzad klu sgrub zhabs/ /zhes dang*/ bar ma gnyis kyi thog ma na yod pa ni/ bya dka'i spyod pas bcu gnyis lor/ /dung dung dad shugs drag po yis/ /mang mang 'gro mgon byams pa nyid/ /bsgrubs pas zhal gzigs thogs med bsngags/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /༈ gnyis pa chod pa'i zung ldan la bcu gsum ste/ dang po gnyis kyi thog ma na yod pa/ dang po dang gsum pa'i thog ma na yod pa/ dang po dang bzhi ba'i thog ma na yod pa/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i thog ma na yod pa/ gnyis pa dang bzhi pa'i thog ma na yod pa/ phyi ma gnyis kyi thog ma na yod pa/ snga ma gsum gyi thog ma na yod pa/ dang po dang phyi ma gnyis kyi thog ma na yod pa/ phyi ma gsum gyi thog ma na yod pa/ bzhi ka'i thog ma na yod pa/ bzhi ka la yod kyang phyed snga phyi mi gcig pa/ mi mnyam gnyis dang mnyam pa gnyis 'dra ba'i thog ma na yod pa/ thog mtha' gnyis dang bar pa gnyis 'dra ba'i thog ma na yod pa'o/ /'di dag las mtshon byed tsam la dang po gnyis kyi thog ma na yod pa ni/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan 'di la/ /kun mkhyen gnyis par rab grags shing*/ /'phags yul paṇa chen kun gyi rje/ /rgyal sras mkhas pa dbyig gi gnyen/ /zhes dang*/ dang mtha' gnyis kyi thog ma na yod pa ni/ mkhas min mu stegs grub pa'i mtha'/ /dngos stobs rigs pa'i ral gri yis/ /tshar bcad thar lam gsal mdzad mkhan/ /mkhas mchog ārya de ba'i zhabs/ /zhes dang*/ bar pa gnyis kyi thog ma na yod pa ni/ mkhyen pa'i gter gyis rjes bzung zhing*/ /zab brling rigs pa'i gzhung gi srol/ /zab gsal dag pa'i blo gros kyis/ /'byed mdzad mkhas dbang phyogs kyi glang*/

/zhes dang*/ /bzhi ka'i thog ma na yod pa ni/ / rab 'bar rigs tshul brgya phrag gis/ /rab mang mu stegs grub mtha'i mun/ / rab bcom rnam dag rgyal ba'i bstan/ /rab dkar gsal mdzad chos kyi grags/ /zhes dang*/ bzhi ka'i thog ma na yod kyang phyed snga phyir mi mnyam pa ni/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i 'dul ba'i don/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin rtogs nas/ /ston la mkhas pa'i phul byung ba/ /ston pa gnyis pa yod tan 'od/ /ces dang*/ yang mi mnyam pa gnyis dang mnyam pa gnyis 'dra ba ni/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin brlabs pas/ /klu sgrub dgongs don thugs chud tshe/ /'jam dpal nyid kyi thugs rje las/ /klu sgrub lugs gsal zla ba grags/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /༈ gsum pa chod cing ma chod pa la gsum ste/ dang po phyed snga ma gnyis 'dra zhing phyi ma gnyis 'dra ba ni/ gsal gsal nyin byed shar ba na/ /gsal gsal gzugs kyi bkod pa mthong*/ /chil chil char ba 'bab pa'i tshe/ /chil chil rgya mtsho rlabs phreng g.yo/ /zhes dang*/ gnyis pa thog tha gnyis 'dra ba ni/ / sil sil gdub bu'i sgra 'khrol bzhin/ snyan snyan rgyud mangs sbreng ba na/ /snyan snyan glu dbyangs len pa dang*/ /sil sil 'og bag sgra yang 'khrol/ /zhes dang*/ gsum pa bzhi ka 'dra ba ni/ dkar dkar zla ba'i gdan steng na/ /dkar dkar dung ltar mdzes pa'i sku/ /dkar dkar zhal dkyil rgyas pa dang*/ /dkar dkar tshems kyi 'phreng bas mdzes/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa bya dka' gnas gzhan na yod pa'i zung ldan la drug ste/ rkang pa bzhi ka'i dbus na yod pa/ mtha' na yod pa/ bar mtha' gnyis na yod pa/ thog bar gnyis na yod pa/ thog mtha' gnyis na yod pa/ gnas gsum na yod pa'i dang po la gnyis las/ dang po chod cing ma chod pa ni/ 'dul ba'i gzhung ma mkhas tshe mkhas zhes grags/ /mngon pa'i chos la mkhas tshe mkhas par gyur/ /mdo sde'i don la mkhas tshe mkhas pa'i dbang*/ /mdo sngags kun la mkhas tshe mkhas rtser

son/ /zhes dang*/ gnyis pa chod pa ni/ smon lam phul byung rnam dag gis bskrun zhing mchog phul byung bde ldan du/ /rnam dkar phul byung tshogs gnyis las 'khrungs ston pa phul byung 'od dpag med/ /rgyal sras phul byung spyan ras gzigs sogs 'khor tshogs phul byung gis bskor nas/ /dam chos phul byung theg chen lam ston go 'phang phul byung mchog la 'god/ /ces dang*/ gnyis pa mtha' na yod pa la gnyis las/ dang po chod pa ni/ rgyal bas lha nang brgya byin lta bur ston/ /lha min gnas su sgra gcan rnam pa ston/ /mi yi yul du 'khor sgyur sogs su ston/ /gang la gang 'dul de yi gzugs su ston/ /zhes dang*/ gnyis pa chod cing ma chod pa ni/ dbyangs can mdzes sku dkar gsal gsal/ /rin chen rgyan mang 'od 'khyug 'khyug /zhal gyi padmo 'dzum mul mul/ /utpal spyan zur g.yo hrig hrig /ces dang*/ gsum pa la gnyis las/ dang po chod pa ni/ gsal byed zla bas utpal rgyas par byed/ /mdzes byed gos kyi skyes bu'i gzugs mdzes byed/ /phan byed chos kyi sdug bsngal las grol byed/ /dag byed chu yis dri ma sel par byed/ /ces dang*/ gnyis pa chod cing mchod pa ni/ 'jigs 'jigs rga dang na bas zin cing 'jigs 'jigs 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /'jigs 'jigs bar do'i snang ba shar dus 'jigs 'jigs 'byung ba'i dgra bzhi dang*/ /'jigs 'jigs snang ba rnam pa gsum sogs 'jigs 'jigs 'khrul snang sna tshogs bcas/ /'jigs 'jigs gshin rjes cho 'phrul bstan la 'jigs 'jigs bros kyang thar ba dka'/ / zhes dang*/ bzhi pa la gnyis las/ dang po chod pa tsam ni/ ngag la dbang bsgyur ngag kun smra ba'i rgyan/ /ngag gi 'dod 'jo ngag tshig don gnyer la/ /ngag dbang lha mos ngag gi dngos stsal nas/ /ngag gi dbang phyug ngag bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /ces dang*/ gnyis pa thog mtha' gnyis na yod pa mi mnyam pa'i chod pa ni/ /mdzes mdzes bzhin ras so phreng dkar mdzes mdzes/

/mdzes mdzes lang tsho'i dpal 'chang mdzes mdzes ldan/ /mdzes mdzes spyod tshul mig zung g.yo mdzes/ /mdzes mdzes 'jo sgeg dal 'gros mdzes mdzes byed/ /ces dang*/ lnga pa la gnyis las dang po chod pa ni/ dkar 'khyil zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar/ /dkar gsal dung gi mdog kyang dkar/ /dkar mdzes me tog kunda dkar/ /dkar mtho gangs ri'i mdog nyid dkar/ /zhes dang*/ gnyis pa chod cing ma chod pa ni/ ldem ldem dpag bsam shing ldem ldem/ /ldem ldem lcags phran ljon ldem ldem/ /ldem ldem dbyangs can sku ldem ldem/ /ldem ldem ral pa'i cog ldem ldem/ /zhes dang*/ drug pa la gnyis las/ dang po chod pa ni/ blo ldan rgyal rnams blo gros mtha' yas blo/ /blo gsal 'jam dbyangs blo gros thogs med blo/ /blo gros zla med blo bzang rgya mtsho'i blo/ /blo rmongs dbang rtul blo chung byis pa'i blo/ /zhes dang*/ gnyis pa chod la mchod pa ni/ dkar dkar gangs kyi ri dbang ji bzhin dkar dkar dbyangs can sku dkar dkar/ /dkar dkar zla ba nya ba'i mdog ltar dkar dkar spyan ras gzigs dkar dkar/ /dkar dkar kunda'i rtsa ba ji bzhin dkar dkar rnam rgyal ma dkar dkar/ /dkar dkar 'o ma'i rgya mtsho'i 'khyil ltar dkar dkar tshe sbyin sgrol dkar dkar/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /༈ gsum pa mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus bskyed mdzad yum/ /yum mchog rje btsun gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma/ /ma gcig khyod la bdag gis gsol btab tshe/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag yas dngos grub stsol/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /༈ bzhi pa kun du zung ldan la gsum/ rkang pa bzlas pa/ tshig bcad bzlas pa/ zung ldan chen po'o/ /dang po la gsum/ dang po dang gsum pa bzlas pa/ phyed phyed bzlas pa/ dang po bzhi pa dang gnyis pa gsum pa dang bzlas pa'o/ /'di dag nye 'kho chung bas mtshon byed tsam la dang po ni/ theg chen shing rta'i srol 'byed mkhan/

/'dzam gling mkhas pa'i dbus na grags/ /theg chen shing rta'i srol 'byed mkhan/ /'dzam gling mkhas pa'i dbus na grags/ /zhes pa lta bu ste klu sgrub dang thogs med dang sbyor/ /de bzhin du gzhan gnyis la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa gzhan rkang pa bzlas pa la gsum/ lan gcig dang gsum dang bzhi bzlas pa'o/ /dang po la drug yod kyang mtshon byed dang po gnyis bzlas pa tsam ni/ gnas lnga rig pa'i mkhas dbang mchog /gnas lnga rig pa'i mkhas dbang mchog /dbyangs can bzhad pa'i rjo rje yi/ /snyan tshig la ni su zhig 'gran/ /zhes pa lta bu ste gzhan rnams la'ang sbyor/ gnyis pa lan gsum bzlas pa la gsum ste dang po gsum bzlas pa tsam ni/ mdzes shing yid la dga' ba skyed/ /mdzes shing yid la dga' ba skyed/ /mdzes shing yid la dga' ba skyed/ /dbyangs can zla ba dung mdog dkar/ /zhes pa lta bu ste gzhan gsum la'ang mtshon no/ gsum pa la lan bzhi bzlas pa ni/ 'od kyis rnam par gsal bar byed/ /ces pa lan bzhi bzlas te nyi ma zla ba rgyu skar sgron me bzhi dang sbyar ba lta bu'o/ /༈ gnyis pa tshigs bcad bzlas pa ni/ rab dkar mdzes pa'i cha rdzogs shing*/ /lta na sdug cing mthong bas kyang*/ /yid la dga' ba'i dpal ster ba/ /gang de 'jig rten 'di na grags/ /zhes dbyangs can ma dang sbyar nas slar yang rab dkar mdzes pa'i cha rdzogs shing*/ zhes sogs zla ba dang sbyar nas brjod pa lta bu'o/ / ༈gsum pa zung ldan chen po ni/ dri med rab gsal dri med gsal/ /zhes pa lan bzhi bzlas nas rkang pa dang po rgyal ba'i thugs dang dbyangs can ma'i sku dang sbyar zhing*/ gnyis pa nam mkha' dang dwangs pa'i mtsho/ gsum pa zla ba dang shel/ bzhi pa spyan ras gzigs dang me long sbyar ba lta bu'o/ /lnga pa bsres pa'i zung ldan ni/ 'dzad pa mchog gis mchog dman 'gro don mdzad/ /mdzad pa ston mkhas mkhas pa'i phul byung yang*/ /yang yang thos bsam tshul la brtson byas tshe/

/tshe 'dir mkhas pa'i pha mthar phyin par 'gyur/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /༈ drug pa ldog pa'i zung ldan la gsum ste/ rkang pa phyed ldog pa/ tshigs bcad phyed ldog pa/ tshigs bcad ldog pa'o/ /dang po la rkang ba phyed ldog pa dang rkang ba ldog pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ blo bzang grags pa grags bzang blo/ /nges par mkhyen ldan mkhyen par nges/ /mkhas mchog 'dren pa 'dren mchog mkhas/ /grub bzang mdzad pas mdzad bzang grub/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dkar mo lha mchog lha yi lha/ /lha yi lha mchog lha mo dkar/ /dad tshe mthong bas dge legs thob/ /thob legs dge bas mthong tshe dad/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa tshigs bcas phyed ldog pa ni/ dkar gsal mdangs ldan bzhin bzang gzugs/ /gdong ba'i mdzes chags 'dod pa'i gnas/ /gnas pa'i 'dod chags mdzes pa'i gdong*/ /gzugs bzang bzhin ldan mdangs gsal dkar/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa tshigs bcad ldog pa ni/ /rgyas zhing dar ba bzang legs chos/ /bde dang phan pas legs pa 'byung*/ /dge zhing bde ldan bzang spyod bya/ /thob phyir brtson pas 'jug cing 'bad/ /'bad cing 'jug pas brtson phyir thob/ /bya spyod bzang ldan bde zhing dge/ /'byung ba legs pas bde dang phan/ /chos legs bzang ba dar zhing rgyas/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa bya dka' ba'i khyad par gzhan la gnyis/ bang lang gcin dang*/ 'khor ba'i bya ba dka' ba'o/ dang po ni/ yi ge rnams re re bar du chod cing steng ma dkyus su bklags pa dang*/ 'og ma 'phar te bklags pa gnyis gzugs gcig pa zhig yin la/ gnyis pa 'khor ba'i bya dka' la phyed 'khor dang kun 'khor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ tshigs bcad gcig gi phyed snga ma dang po dkyus dang thur du bklags pa 'dra zhing*/ phyed phyi ma dkyus dang thur du bklags pa 'dra ba zhig go /gnyis pa kun 'khor la gzhung gis dngos su bstan pa dang*/ ma bstan pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ phyed snga ma'i dang po steng nas dkyus dang thur/

'og nas gyen dang yar ldog pa zhig ste/ kun bzang 'khor lo zhes grags so/ /'di dang snga ma gnyis bcas dgos pa mi che bas bzhag go /༈ gnyis pa la bai darbha dang*/ kha che'i lugs gnyis kyi dang po la sgor mo dang*/ phyi ma'i lugs kyi kun 'khor ni gru bzhir gzhung las 'byung ba bzhin yin te/ gnyis ka nyams tshar du/ mkhas pa'i dgongs pa dang mi 'gal bas rang blos gang thon zhig 'jug tu 'god par bya'o/ gsum pa la dbyangs dang gnas dang yi ge nges pa gsum gyi dang po/ dbyangs nges pa'i tshul bsdus te mtshon tsam ni/ mtha' yas sangs rgyas sras bcas la/ /nyin bzhin 'di phyi gnyis kyi phyir/ lus btud gus 'dud dus kun du/ /g.yel med bshes gnyen legs bsten te/ /mchod do bstod do 'dod don stsol/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ / gnyis pa gnas nges pa la bzhi yod cing*/ de ni rgya gar gyi yi ge'i dbang du byas nas a ā dang ka kha ga gha nga lta bu mgrin pa'i gnas las skyes pa ltar gzhan rnams kyang rang rang gi skye gnas gang yin las skyes par mtshungs pa'i yi ge rnams bsgrigs pa yin la/ bod yig la ni ka kha ga nga rnams kyang mgrin pa'i gnas las skyes bar 'jogs pas/ de 'dra phyogs gcig bsgrigs pa lta bu dang*/ de bzhin du ta tha da na rnams ni lce rtse dang so las skyes la/ pa pha ba ma rnams ni mchu las skyes pa lta bu ste/ dang po ni/ da lta 'di na dad ldan mthong*/ /zhes dang*/ phyi ma ni/ pha ma mi pham bu mo spangs/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa yi ge nges pa la yang bzhi ste/ mtshon tsam ni/ kang kang king king kung kung kung*/ /tang tang ting ting tog tog tog /shang shang shib shib shing shog shub/ /rang rang re re ri ru'i rwa/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gzhan lhag ma gab tshig gi skor dang*/ skyon bcu spong tshul sogs ni mang du dogs nas bzhag go / ༈ 'phros don me long ma 'di'i le'u dang po nas 'byung ba 'ga' zhig zhar byung du brjod na/

sdeb sbyor gyi sgo nas yi ge bgrang ba bṛtta dang*/ phyi mo bgrang ba dzā ti zhes pa gnyis yod cing*/ de yang rgya skad kyi dbang du mdzad la/ dmar ser can dang rgyal ba'i lha gnyis kyis mdzad pa'i sdeb sbyor dang*/ khyad par du paṇa chen shanti pas mdzad pa'i sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas ni 'phags yul du grags che zhing*/ de ni dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge lci yang bsgrigs pa'i sgo nas sbyor zhing yi ge lci yang rags rtsis sam dmigs bsal ma gtogs 'thug po dang ring cha can dang mtha' rten can dang au lta bu/ srog zhugs lta bu ni lci la/ de lta bu min pa'i yi ge re re ba ni yang ba ste/ lci ba la rtag 'khyog po dang yang ba la drang po yod de/ bod yig la de lta bu'i sdeb sbyor bya tshul ji bzhin med kyang mtshon byed tsam la 'phul rten yod pa'i yi ge rnams ni lci la/ de med pa phal cher ni yang ba'o/ /'on kyang bod skad la dag yig dang snyan ngag nas 'byung ba ltar gyi sdeb sbyor ni yod de/ tshig sbyor de dag nas 'byung ba dang mthun par sbyor ba ni bod skad kyi sdeb sbyor bya tshul yin pa'i phyir ro/ /snyan ngag la rigs kyi sgo nas grol ba dang rigs dang mdzod dang 'dus pa sde bzhi yod pa'i dang po ni/ sho lo ka gcig gis brjod bya'i don de rdzogs par ston nus pa zhig ste/ pad dkar bsil zer rgyas pa'i steng*/ /tshangs sras lha mo yid 'phrog ma/ /rgyud mangs sgra las ngag gi dpal/ /ster mdzad rgyal ba'i yum der 'dud/ /ces pa lta bu/ rigs ni/ bsngags brjod kyi yul gcig la sho lo ka du ma yod cing bya ba'i tshig gcig gis thams cad gsal nus pa zhig ste/ 'grel ba ltar na/ 'jam gnyen chu skyes gzhon nu yi/ /brtan pa ci yang 'phrog byed pa'i/ khyod bzhin zla ba gsar ba 'di/ /gzhan yid 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bzhin/ /'ja' tshon lta bu'i mig gi dkyus/ /zur gyis ring por bstan pa

ni/ /rna rgyan utpal gzhon nu la/ /'gran pa'i ched du 'ong ba bzhin/ /so phreng ze'u 'bru rgod pa can/ /mchu sgros bim pa ltar dmar ba'i/ /dga' mas sred ldan dga' ba bskyed/ /ces pa lta bu mdzes ma'i gdong la bstod pa la dga' ba bskyed ces bya tshig gcig gis gsal ba lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du mdzod ni/ gcod mtshams sna tshogs pa'i ngos nas sho lo ka du ma la bya tshig sogs mang nyung nges pa med cing brjod bya du ma dang ldan pa'o/ /'dus pa ni/ brjod bya'i don gcig la sho lo ka du ma dang bya tshig du ma yod pa zhig go /snyan ngag chen po la sngon du shis brjod dang*/ de nas phyag bya ba dang*/ de nas brtsams bya dang mthun par dam bca' brjod pa'i dngos po'i nges bstan rnams sngon du 'gro bas rtsom pa dngos la 'jug go /gzhung du snyan ngag gi lus srog ces tha snyad byas pa'i lus ni bcad lhug spel ma gsum yin la/ srog la sde bzhi zhes bshad pa'i sde bzhi ni/ chos dang don dang 'dod pa dang thar ba bzhi'o/ /de la chos ni/ mngon mtho dang nges legs sgrub pa'i rgyu/ don ni rig byed sogs mang du thos pa dang dgos don rin po che sogs srung ba dang spel ba/ 'dod pa ni/ lha mi'i yul dang yo byad la longs spyod pa/ thar pa ni/ byang chub sgrub pa lta bu'o/ /snyan ngag smra ba la skad rigs bzhi yod kyang legs sbyar ma gtogs gzhan gsum zur chag tu 'gyur zhing*/ khyad par du grong tshig rnams snyan ngag la zur chag tu 'gro yang brjod tshul mkhas na ni mi 'gal lo/ /gzhung du skabs 'dir rgya gar lho phyogs bai darbha dang*/ shar phyogs go ḍa pa'i lugs kyi yon tan bcu la 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba'i bshad pa mang du 'byung ba ni 'dir dgos pa chung bas bzhag go /'on kyang sgra'i nyams/ don gyi nyams/ gnyis ka la grong tshig spong tshul dang gsum bshad pa'i dang po ni/ rgya gar gyi dbang du byas pa'i yi ge la bskor ba la dpe byas nas bod kyi yi ge la skor ba zhig ste/

de yang tshig rkang bzhi'i thog ma ka yig sogs la skor ba dang*/ thog mtha' bar gsum gang yang rung bar yi ge la skor ba dang*/ tshig rkang bzhi'i thog tha'i yi ge 'dra bar skor ba sogs la rjes 'khrid ces pa'i tha snyad mdzad do/ /'di dag le'u gnyis pa nas 'byung ba'i rgyan dang 'dra bar bshad kyang khyad par ni yod do/ /gnyis pa sgra rgyan tsam du ma zad don rgyan gyi nyams khyad par can dang ldan pa zhig go /gsum pa la don gyi grong spong ba dang*/ sgra'i grong pa spang pa gnyis kyi dang po la/ spang bya dang*/ spong byed gnyis kyi dang po ni 'grel bar 'gyur ba ltar bkod na 'khrig pa 'dod pa lta bu'i tshe/ yid du 'ong ba'i bu mo khyod/ /'bol zhing 'jam pa'i mal stan la/ bdag dang lhan cig nyal byas nas/ 'khrig pa'i bde la dga' mgur spyod/ /ces pa lta bu grong tshig gis mi mdzes par smra ba'o/ /gnyis pa spong byed ni 'khrig pa'i ched yin kyang de mdzes par brjod pa zhig ste/ 'dren byed zur gyis lta ba'i 'od/ /bdag yid 'dab brgya ci yang bzhad/ /dbang po'i bung ba chu skyes kyi/ /rtsed 'jor rol cig smin legs ma/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gcod mtshams nyams pa'i grong tshig ni/ grub chen nyams len byed 'dod blo/ /chung chung phug par nyal bar dga'/ /phyag chen bsgoms pas nyon mongs kun/ /'phel byed mtha' dag zhi bar byed/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du le'u gsum pa nas bshad pa'i skyon bcu ci rigs spong dgos shing*/ 'di'i tshig rkang phyi ma gsum gyi 'go'i tshig rnams snga ma snga ma dang sbyor tshul mi legs pas gcod mtshams nyams pa yin la/ dmigs bsal kā la rū pa rab brjid drag po'i sku/ /zhes sogs kyi rkang pa bar ba gnyis thog ma snga ma dang sbyor tshul mi bde ba ltar snang yang*/ don la ni ka 'phreng dang sbyor ba'i ched yin pas mi 'gal ste de 'dra gzhan yang mang ngo*/ /tshig gi nyams 'don tshul la rnam grangs mang yang 'di'i 'grel ba'i mchod brjod dang 'jug gi tshigs bcad rnams nyams 'don tshul shin tu legs la mdzes pa'i nyams ni/

rjes mdzad pa'i bde mchog gi mchod phreng du/ ting 'dzin pir gyis bris pa'i smin legs gzugs/ zhes sogs lta bu'o/ /yang grong tshig gam phal skad du brjod na mi mdzes pas gzugs can gyi rgyan dang sbyar ba'i gab tshig gi sgo nas nyams 'don tshul ni/ dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs dang*/ gsang 'dus kyi mchod pa'i skabs gsang ba'i 'khor lor ind+ra nī la ltar/ zhes sogs lta bu ste mang ngo/ /'jigs byed shis brjod kyi 'gor/ 'chi med lam kun khyab pa'i chu 'dzin ni/ /bgrang yas nyi 'od rtse dgas rol pa bzhin/ /zhes pa lta bu ni brjid pa'i nyams 'don tshul legs shing*/ de la/ nam mkha'i khams kun khyab pa'i sprin phung la/ /grangs med nyi ma'i 'od kyis 'phogs pa bzhin/ /zhes sbyar na'ang nyams yod kyang sngon ma nyid bzang ngo*/ /tshig gi nyams 'don tshul rgyan kun la yod kyang gzugs can gyi rgyan dang sbyor shes na mdzes shing*/ /'dir mtshon pa tsam te rgyas par gzhan du shes rab bya'o/ /spyir byams mgon gyis/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs dgos shing ma sbyangs na 'phags pa yin kyang thams cad mkhyen pa thob mi nus zhes bshad pa ltar yin la/ mdo las kyang*/ dpe'i chos gsal bar bya ba'i snyan ngag bya'o/ /gzhan yang dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa bya'o/ /de las bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la bstod pa/ /gsal bar 'gyur ba'i snyan ngag 'bad par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar snyan ngag la ni 'dod gtam gtso bor ma brjod par dkon mchog gsum dang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams la bstod pa phul zhing*/ las 'bras dang mthun pa'i tshig brjod na ni nang rig pa'i gzhung du 'gyur bas phan yon kyang che la/ khyad par du rjes rin po che gsum gyi gtam gyi sbyor ba las/ rigs lam phra mo 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod dang*/ /gzhung lugs gdams par shar ba'i nyams len dang*/

/tshig sbyor tshul la mkhas pa'i ngag gi dpal/ / sa steng 'di na rin chen rnam gsum snang*/ /zhes mkhas pa'i rgyan rin po che rnam pa gsum gsungs pa'i phyi ma tshig sbyor la mkhas pa'i rgyas bshad du/ tshigs bcad lhugs pa gnyis la spel ba'i lus/ /don dang tshig gi rgyan la sogs pa yi/ /mdzes byed rgyan gyis spud pa'i tshig sbyor tshul/ /snyan dngags gzhung bzhin legs par sbyar ba na/ /blo gsal rnams la dga' ba rgyas par byed/ /ces snyan ngag la sbyang dgos par gsungs pas de shes dgos la shes na gsung rab kyi don mang po shes pa'i rkyen byed cing*/ khyad par du rtsom pa'i tshig rgyan la mi rmongs so/ /des na snyan ngag shes pa'i dgos pa'i gtso bo de ltar du go bar bya'i/ yi ge bskur ba la snyan ngag shes dgos pa ni de'i dgos don phal pa'o/ /༈ smras pa/ tha snyad rig gnas rig pa'i mkhas mang yang*/ /me long dgongs don dgongs pa bzhin gzigs nas/ /gzhan la ston mkhas ston pa'i ched 'bad pa/ /rin chen don 'grub don gyi paṇḍi ta/ /gang gis legs bshad bdud rtsi'i bcud myangs pas/ /blo gros lus stobs rgyas pa'i bung ba zhig / snyan tshig sgra dbyangs sgrog dang lhan cig tu/ /rmad byung dga' ba'i gar gyis mkha' la brel/ /snyan ngag rgya mtsho rlabs 'phreng g.yo ba der/ /blo dman zla ba'i mtshan mas brgal dka' yang*/ /dbyangs can bzhad pa'i ded dpon la brten nas/ /snyan tshig chu gter dbus su phyin nam snyam/ /tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i 'o mtsho las 'khrungs pa'i/ /kunda'i mdog dang mtshungs pa'i rnam dkar zlas/ /blo gsal tshogs kyi rmongs mun rab bsal nas/ /kun mkhyen lha lam dbyings su 'jug gyur cig /snyan ngag gi rgyan gnyis so so'i dbye ba'i dpe brjod blo ldan dga' byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ co ne'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mdo sngags rigs gnas kun la sbyangs pa'i mkhas dbang mkhan rin po che blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sku zhabs rgyal khab chen po pho brang du byon nas bzhugs pa'i skabs gsung shog gnang sbyin dang bcas te/

khyed kyis dgon pa'i khri pa sogs dka' ram 'di rnams la snyan ngag 'khrid dgos zhes bskul ba'i bka' gyen du bzlog ma nus par/ rang gis gang shes 'khrid pa'i tshe khong rnams kyis snyan ngag so so'i dpe brjod rgyas pa zhig byung na legs zhes bskul ba la brten nas/ /shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub kyis don gnyer can 'ga' la'ang phan srid snyam pa'i 'dun pas co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba ste/ de nas snyan ngag dang mdo sngags kyi gzhung don du ma legs par mkhyen cing dad dang rnam dpyod zung du 'brel ba'i mo ne'i khri pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang nas bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhan rin po che'i bzhed pa skong ba dang*/ gzhan la'ang phan thogs 'dod pa'i thugs 'dun gyis bar du brko bar bzhed pa'i tshe/ par gyi yi ge pa ni snyan ngag yig sdeb sogs kyi rig gnas la brtson pa che ba'i dka' bcu blo bzang dbang phyug go ///maṅga laṃ// //
